phases.frontendCheck: Separate process wall time for tsrust check and strict TypeScript tsc --noEmit on deterministic generated declarations. Includes process startup and source reads. Native specialization and TypeScript structural checking differ; compare actual frontend cost, not equivalent validation coverage.
phases.frontendEmit: Separate tsrust emit process wall time, including startup and source reads; excludes rustc and execution. Distinct nominal argument records require distinct Box applications even though each argument has an identical field shape.

acceptance: Validate all counts with check.py before measuring. Preserve generated sources and hashes, generator identity, commands, compiler/toolchain identities and individual samples in canonical SQLite at the checkpoint. Do not describe generic specialization as runtime throughput.
